headline: Post-midterm AI selloff rattles Wall Street while Indian markets post their best week in six years and Andhra Pradesh counts local body votes.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh MPTC/ZPTC vote counting under way
stories.summary: Counting of votes for ZPTC and MPTC elections began across 365 centres in Andhra Pradesh, with about 11,000 supervisors and 28,692 staff involved. Nearly 20,000 police are deployed in a three-layer security arrangement, and postal ballots are counted first.
stories.why_it_matters: A direct read on grassroots political strength in your home state.

stories.title: Visakhapatnam readies for CII Partnership Summit
stories.summary: Officials were told to make foolproof arrangements for the CII Partnership Summit on November 12-13 at Andhra University Engineering College grounds in Visakhapatnam.
stories.why_it_matters: A major investment event for Andhra Pradesh that could affect jobs and industry in the state.

stories.title: AP issues guidelines to curb illegal sand and mineral mining
stories.summary: A G.O. assigns responsibilities to departments and provides time-bound verification of complaints, joint field inspections and stringent enforcement. It also sets accountability for derelict officials.
stories.why_it_matters: State policy change in Andhra Pradesh on a long-running governance issue.

stories.title: Telangana plans ₹20,000-crore urban climate-resilience pipeline
stories.summary: The state is drawing up a project pipeline and policy measures including cool roofs, bamboo shelters, sewage treatment, waste reclamation and digital water monitoring. The aim is to prepare cities for rising temperatures and erratic rainfall.
stories.why_it_matters: Large state spending plan affecting Telangana cities including Hyderabad.

stories.title: Vaishnaw puts onus on social platforms for online harm
stories.summary: The IT minister said social media companies can no longer act as passive intermediaries and must take responsibility for harm like cyber fraud and digital arrest scams. He stopped short of clarifying safe-harbour protections.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals possible changes to intermediary liability rules affecting Indian tech platforms.

stories.title: Ongole boat capsize toll rises to seven
stories.summary: Two more bodies of Tamil Nadu fishermen washed ashore, taking the toll to seven in the Ongole boat capsize.
stories.why_it_matters: A fatal incident off the Andhra Pradesh coast.

stories.title: Semicon 2.0 application portal launched
stories.summary: The government opened the portal for Semicon 2.0, initially for three of six pillars: machines and materials, fabs, and packaging. Vaishnaw said it wants only serious players.
stories.why_it_matters: Shapes India's semiconductor industry push and future hiring.

stories.title: Delhi air 'very poor' at AQI 364
stories.summary: Delhi schools were directed to run classes up to class 5 in hybrid mode as air quality worsened.
stories.why_it_matters: The annual pollution crisis is back in the national capital.

stories.title: Iran war cost helped Democrats win US midterms
stories.summary: Democrats won the midterms, with analysis attributing the backlash against Trump's party partly to the costs of the Iran war reaching American homes. Strategists say dozens of Democrats are already eyeing 2028 runs.
stories.why_it_matters: A US political shift with consequences for trade, tech regulation and markets.

stories.title: Paraguay's President Peña impeached and arrested amid banking crisis
stories.summary: Santiago Peña was ousted over a banking crisis that left millions unable to access their money. He was moved to a military base for protection.
stories.why_it_matters: A dramatic political and financial collapse in a country.

stories.title: Israel struggles to form government
stories.summary: President Herzog faces a key choice as Eisenkot's bloc and Arab-led parties seek to oust Netanyahu. Failure to form a government could leave him in power.
stories.why_it_matters: Determines leadership in a central Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Russia strikes Kyiv
stories.summary: A missile attack damaged buildings and injured two civilians after Zelenskyy warned of new attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: The war in Ukraine continues to escalate.

stories.title: Iran threatens subsea cables as ships loiter nearby
stories.summary: Iran said it would attack subsea cables if the US escalates military strikes again, while ships were reported near cables.
stories.why_it_matters: Subsea cables carry global internet traffic, including India's connectivity.

stories.title: New Zealand election neck and neck
stories.summary: Early results show National and Labour close, with neither likely to govern alone.
stories.why_it_matters: An election outcome still undecided.

stories.title: Bomb-threat wave hits European flights
stories.summary: Scores of flights across Europe received hoax threats this week with no explosives found. A Russian extremist group denied sending them.
stories.why_it_matters: Aviation disruption in Europe.

stories.title: Nifty gains 8.58% in best week in six years
stories.summary: Indian stocks rose for a seventh straight session, adding nearly ₹28 lakh crore in market value. Foreign inflows, easing crude, a stronger rupee and solid earnings supported the rally; RIL rose 13%.
stories.why_it_matters: A big move for your index-fund holdings, driven by falling oil.

stories.title: India 10-year bond posts best week in 7 years
stories.summary: Yields fell as crude dropped after the US midterms and foreign investors bought bonds. This eases pressure on the RBI to keep yields elevated.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals a friendlier rate backdrop.

stories.title: Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion AI rout
stories.summary: A sharp selloff raised doubts over AI infrastructure valuations and spending, with Democratic control of Congress adding regulatory worries. Markets rebounded Friday, with the Nasdaq up 1.73% but still posting a fourth straight weekly decline.
stories.why_it_matters: AI-led global volatility feeds into Indian tech sentiment.

stories.title: Strong US payrolls lift dollar; Fed hike odds near 80%
stories.summary: The US added 165,000 jobs, far above forecasts, and the probability of a Fed hike next month rose to nearly 80%. Gold fell 0.3% to $4,074.36.
stories.why_it_matters: Higher-for-longer US rates affect FPI flows and the rupee.

stories.title: RBI gold loan rule changes explained
stories.summary: New rules raise loan-to-value limits for small borrowers and bring transparent valuation and stronger auction safeguards. They also set jewellery return deadlines and compensation rules.
stories.why_it_matters: Practical personal-finance rules that affect borrowers.

stories.title: Edelweiss head urges scrapping equity tax on foreigners
stories.summary: Rashesh Shah said India should remove capital gains tax on foreign investors to revive the stock market and support the rupee.
stories.why_it_matters: Possible tax policy change affecting flows and market direction.

stories.title: Muhurat trading on Diwali, November 8
stories.summary: Muhurat trading marks the start of Samvat 2083, with limited liquidity and key resistance levels making caution essential.
stories.why_it_matters: Special market session timing.

stories.title: Bank holiday Saturday ahead of Diwali
stories.summary: Branches of public and private banks may be open or closed on Saturday, 7 November; check the RBI calendar.
stories.why_it_matters: Practical for banking errands.

stories.title: Razorpay's ₹6,000 cr IPO plans
stories.summary: Inc42 examines MDR and AI as factors that could shape Razorpay's ₹6,000 crore IPO.
stories.why_it_matters: A major fintech listing relevant to your sector.

stories.title: OYO parent PRISM profit up 17% ahead of IPO
stories.summary: IPO-bound PRISM reported consolidated PAT of ₹353 crore in Q1, up 17% YoY.
stories.why_it_matters: Financial data for an upcoming listing.

stories.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion after $11B raise
stories.summary: OpenAI raised $11 billion, scaled back from earlier plans of over $30 billion, with more funds that may take the total to $20 billion expected to close. It raised $122 billion at an $852 billion valuation in March, and rival Anthropic is nearing its IPO.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows AI capital markets are still funding labs, though investor sentiment is shifting.

stories.title: Midterms and AI: data center restrictions win
stories.summary: Voters faced 41 data center-related ballot measures and in all but one backed more restrictions. Democratic wins could reshape the AI industry's regulatory outlook.
stories.why_it_matters: Regulatory and infrastructure headwinds affect AI hiring and spending.

stories.title: Ramp data: AI spending stalls as usage climbs
stories.summary: Usage keeps rising but spending has stalled, with price cuts and cost controls among big spenders. This could challenge assumptions about AI hypergrowth as Anthropic nears IPO.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful signal on enterprise AI demand.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
stories.summary: Google introduced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, which drew 317 points on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: A new model to evaluate for AI engineering.

stories.title: China recruited Megaspeed exec to spy on Jensen Huang: NYT
stories.summary: The Ministry of State Security reportedly enlisted Alice Huang to glean information on US AI chips and potentially influence Nvidia on China access.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights the geopolitics around AI chips.

stories.title: Palo Alto in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks is reportedly in talks to buy Clutch for $500M; it was last valued at $85 million.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent security is becoming a hot category.

stories.title: Amazon lets users text Alexa to shop
stories.summary: Alexa for Shopping will let users text to compare products, track deals and complete purchases, rolling out to millions in coming weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: Example of agentic commerce moving into consumer products.

stories.title: AI is dramatically accelerating AI research
stories.summary: A widely discussed essay argues AI is speeding up AI research, with 267 points and 210 comments on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: Informs how you think about the field.

stories.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials for all customers
stories.summary: The company described a multifront cyberattack involving AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
stories.why_it_matters: A serious breach at a fintech/security vendor with lessons on credential handling.

stories.title: Firecracker VM escape write-up
stories.summary: A security blog describes a Firecracker VM escape in part 2 of PwnEscape.
stories.why_it_matters: Firecracker underpins many serverless and cloud isolation systems.

stories.title: Yelp blends native and server-driven UI for AI assistant
stories.summary: Yelp's CHAOS framework separates view configuration from conversation data and supports backend-driven chat interactions. It enables faster UI updates without app releases.
stories.why_it_matters: A practical architecture for AI product engineering.

stories.title: Edera isolates credentials from AI agent workloads
stories.summary: Edera's Object Capability Bounded Authority separates an agent's authority from its credentials using hypervisor-enforced capabilities.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to securing agent deployments.

stories.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production
stories.summary: NBC reports Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production after years of poor sales.
stories.why_it_matters: Notable big-tech product reversal.

stories.title: Indian startups raise $255M this week
stories.summary: Twenty Indian startups raised a combined $255M in the first week of November, per Inc42.
stories.why_it_matters: Funding indicator for startup hiring.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip buys majority stake in Quick Ride
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip acquired a majority stake in Bengaluru-based Quick Ride to enter ride pooling.
stories.why_it_matters: Indian tech consolidation.

stories.title: ED searches CoinDCX and Delta Exchange
stories.summary: The ED searched three premises linked to the exchanges over alleged illegal cross-border transfers.
stories.why_it_matters: Regulatory scrutiny in Indian fintech.

stories.title: India bowl first in rainy Wellington ODI
stories.summary: The second ODI was cut to 47 overs a side with more reductions possible, both teams unchanged. New Zealand look to level the series.
stories.why_it_matters: Live Indian team series.

stories.title: Mohammed Shami retires from Tests
stories.summary: The 36-year-old finishes as India's sixth-most successful fast bowler.
stories.why_it_matters: The end of a major Indian pace career.

stories.title: Jaiswal 102 and Sudharsan 77* put India A ahead
stories.summary: Jaiswal scored 102 off 138 after 155 not out in the previous game, ahead of the Test series against New Zealand.
stories.why_it_matters: Good form signal before the Tests.

stories.title: Khawaja says whole Australian team knew of 2018 sandpaper plan
stories.summary: In his autobiography, Khawaja says it was all of them and that he was never interviewed by CA about Cape Town 2018.
stories.why_it_matters: Reopens a major cricket scandal.
